entries.name: Runway
entries.notes: Runway's current product home for AI video and content tools. The homepage offers an enterprise trial.

entries.name: Kling AI
entries.notes: Video and image studio for text, image, and reference prompts.

entries.name: Luma
entries.notes: Creative platform for video and image generation with Ray and Uni models. The site says to try it free.

entries.name: Pika
entries.notes: Creative platform for AI video, image, and audio, including hosted routes to other generators.

entries.name: Veo
entries.notes: Google DeepMind page for Veo 3.1 video generation.

entries.name: Hailuo
entries.notes: MiniMax video and image studio. The homepage currently features MiniMax H3.

entries.name: Seedance
entries.notes: Official ByteDance Seedance page, including Seedance 1.0 video examples and benchmarks.

entries.name: Wan 2.2
entries.notes: Open weights and code for the Wan 2.2 large-scale video model.

entries.name: Vidu
entries.notes: AI video generator for text, image, and reference workflows.

entries.name: Viggle
entries.notes: Video and 3D workspace for remakes, scenes, characters, and motion.

entries.name: Descript
entries.notes: Text-based AI editor for video and audio. The site says to try it free.

entries.name: Kapwing
entries.notes: Browser editor that generates and edits videos from a prompt.

entries.name: Opus Clip
entries.notes: Turns long videos into short clips and can publish them to social platforms.

entries.name: VEED
entries.notes: Video workspace for generation, editing, dubbing, and subtitles.

entries.name: Captions
entries.notes: AI video generator and editor aimed at ready-to-share social cuts.

entries.name: DaVinci Resolve
entries.notes: Blackmagic editor and color tool with a free version and a paid Studio upgrade.

entries.name: invideo
entries.notes: AI video editor for creating and revising clips in the browser.

entries.name: Topaz Video
entries.notes: Desktop video enhancer for upscaling, smoothing, stabilizing, and sharpening footage.

entries.name: Magnific
entries.notes: Creative platform whose tools include video and image upscaling plus generation.

entries.name: Upscayl
entries.notes: Free and open-source desktop AI image upscaler.

entries.name: Video2X
entries.notes: Open-source framework for machine-learning video super-resolution and frame interpolation.

entries.name: Sync
entries.notes: Lip-sync and visual dubbing studio and API.

entries.name: HeyGen
entries.notes: Avatar and talking-video platform. The site says to try it free.

entries.name: LivePortrait
entries.notes: Open-source portrait animation project, now under Kling AI Research.

entries.name: D-ID
entries.notes: Platform for AI-generated presenter and talking-head video.

entries.name: Synthesia
entries.notes: Business AI video platform for presenter-style training and communication videos.
